content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "no", "applies_why": "The judge text does not weigh pressed witnesses chain against chain or verse by verse; it notes the challenged limb was dropped so no live link remains.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "none", "why": "The rule governs chain-against-chain collisions over a live pressed link, but the judge addresses a link already dropped, so no K-C weighing is required."}
